title: Safeguard Rule
description: A single compliance rule. This definition is identical to the $defs.rule embedded in policy.schema.json; scripts/test-schema.py asserts the parity so the two cannot drift.

id.description: ASCII identifier of at most 32 bytes (RuleId width in safeguard-core).

permitted.description: Regions that may hold and transact the token.

restricted.description: Regions that need review; trigger the rule action.

prohibited.description: Regions that may not transact; trigger the rule action.

rule.description: A single rule: stable shape mirrored by rule.schema.json (asserted by scripts/test-schema.py).

id.description: Rule id, unique within the policy version (e.g. "SANCTIONS-001").

type.description: Rule category; maps to safeguard_core::rule::RuleType labels.

action.description: What the rule does when its condition is met; maps to safeguard_core::rule::RuleAction.

regions.description: Required for jurisdiction rules; forbidden for other types. Classifies regions into permitted/restricted/prohibited; the rule action applies to restricted, prohibited and unknown regions (fail-closed).
